  id = {EDN-88},
  title = {The \texorpdfstring{\texttt{/\allowbreak{}predict}}{/predict} p95 target is 250 ms on the one-vCPU VM, served by one worker (\#143)},
  date = {2026-10-31},
  milestone = {M4: Model Deployment},

  participants = {@lukas2510 decided (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/143}{issue \#143})},
  decision = {A Locust load test on the VM, 20 requests/s for 5 minutes, settles NFR-02 to NFR-04 and NFR-10.
NFR-02's \texttt{/\allowbreak{}predict} target rises from 200 to 250 ms at the 95th percentile; the other endpoints' 300 ms and NFR-03, NFR-04 and NFR-10 are confirmed as measured.
Production runs one API worker.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Keep 200 ms and optimise \texttt{/\allowbreak{}predict}: the miss is 10 ms in the tail of one shared vCPU, not in the typical answer.
\item Two workers: no CPU to add on one vCPU, and twice the memory.
\item k6 instead of Locust: adds a JavaScript toolchain, while Locust is Python and can replay M6's \texttt{ES} listings.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} With one worker \texttt{/\allowbreak{}predict} answered in 65 ms at the median and 210 ms at p95, with 98.5\,\% within 300 ms, and no request of 5,883 failed.
Two workers made the tail slower (p95 240 ms) and the memory peak 609 MiB instead of 295 MiB, and with them a hung worker escapes the healthcheck (EDN-93).},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI ran both runs on the VM, checked that the image and the container did not change during them, and recommended each option; @lukas2510 chose each option from the measured values the AI presented.
AI checked Locust's own CPU with \texttt{ps} before relying on it.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-31 on the load test on the VM, question ``NFR-02: The /predict target (p95 at most 200 ms) is missed narrowly on the 1-core VM with 210 ms. What to do?'' (translated from German), answered with the recommended option.},
